_approach: Samplesound's 'falling forward' trick: tuned tom hits sit on the 16th right before beats 2, 3 and 4 at low velocity so they tumble into the next kick, over a plain 4x4 floor with an 8th shaker, soft claps and offbeat hats. A high conga answers in bar 2. Ref: Caiiro 'Ndikhokhele' (2019), Enoo Napa 'Phoenix' (2020). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
